dct_description_sm: This data is the result of targeted brook trout (Salvelinus fontinalis) detection from two creeks in Southwestern Ontario: Hanlon Creek in Guelph ON, and 12-Mile Creek near Pelham ON. The purpose of this data was to determine whether or not brook trout were occupying the two creeks during the time of sampling. This dataset contains the raw qPCR files obtained from the MIC thermocycler as well as the formatted data set, metadata including electrofishing results, and R scripts used for analysis.
dct_title_s: Detection of brook trout in spatiotemporally separate locations using validated eDNA technology
